name: Wine Tourism and Cellar Door Grant — Round 8 (AU)
source: Wine Australia — Wine Tourism and Cellar Door Grant, Grant program guidelines Round 8 (khách cung cấp 2026-09-07). Nhóm quỹ: Industry-focused (khoanh vùng ngành sản xuất rượu).

rules.title_vi: Là nhà sản xuất rượu vang hoặc cider
rules.quote: To be eligible for the Wine Tourism and Cellar Door Grant applicants must: a. be a wine or cider producer
rules.title_en: Is a wine or cider producer

rules.title_vi: Pháp nhân có ABN hoạt động + đăng ký GST
rules.quote: b. be a legal entity registered for GST and with an active ABN
rules.title_en: Entity with an active ABN + GST registration

rules.quote: c. have made at least $1,207,000 (GST exclusive) in sales of rebatable wine in the relevant financial year

rules.title_vi: Có doanh số cellar door nội địa vượt phần dùng cho ngưỡng
rules.quote: d. accrue rebatable domestic cellar door sales in excess of any such sales used to meet the $1,207,000 (GST exclusive) thresholds in the relevant financial year
rules.title_en: Domestic cellar-door sales in excess of those used for the threshold

rules.title_vi: Đã nộp thuế WET cho các doanh số dùng trong hồ sơ
rules.quote: e. have paid the WET on all eligible sales used as part of the application
rules.title_en: WET paid on the sales used in the application

rules.title_vi: Sở hữu hoặc thuê CELLAR DOOR VẬT LÝ tại Úc trong năm tài chính
rules.quote: f. have owned or leased a physical cellar door in Australia in the relevant financial year, and/or their related entity/ies have owned or leased a physical cellar door in Australia in the relevant financial year.
rules.title_en: Owns or leases a PHYSICAL CELLAR DOOR in Australia during the financial year

rules.title_vi: Giấy phép rượu (liquor licence) hợp lệ trong năm tài chính
rules.quote: g. have a liquor licence valid in the relevant financial year.
rules.title_en: Valid liquor licence during the financial year

rules.title_vi: ≥ 50% doanh số cellar door là bán trực tiếp tại cellar door vật lý
rules.quote: at least 50 per cent of the rebatable domestic cellar door sales used in the grant application consist of sales from the physical cellar door
rules.title_en: ≥ 50% of cellar-door sales made directly at a physical cellar door

rules.quote: an annual grant of up to $100,000 (GST exclusive) for their eligible rebatable domestic cellar door sales
rules.title_en: Grant capped at $100,000 per year (excl. GST)
